pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark regions exhibit sub-polygonal geometry with rounded vertices and smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Relative spatial area is larger on the flank than on the visible portions of the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light pelage with regular tri-nodal intersections. Pixel thickness is consistent across the mid-body, maintaining a clear separation between dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal neck mane, appearing as a dark textured line against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A structural gap or thinning of the mane is visible at the anatomical transition between the neck and the shoulder ridge.
